messages:
Tara: quick heads-up — ran a 500-account sample for next-quarter cohort. Playbook triggers executed but ~18% of accounts show owner=null while healthscore stayed low (0.55). Dump uploaded: drive.redwood/qa/owner-smokecheck.csv. Suspect CRM contact role mapping changed during last connector sync (Primary -> Admin). Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

Devon: saw a blip on Friday in the import logs. Might be the new GSuite connector fix. @Anika — did the mapping change go out? :eyes:

Anika: yep, we pushed a mapping tweak on Friday to normalize roles. Looks like the mapping defaulted Admin for legacy imports. I can revert but we should be cautious — need to avoid flipping legit Admins.

Leo: short-term mitigation: gate the playbook rule with owner_claimed IS NOT NULL so we don't send nudges to ownerless accounts. I can open a tiny PR to add that condition to the rule engine.

Tara: good call. Also suggest backfill only for accounts where contact.verified = true to avoid claiming wrong ownership from shaky legacy data. We should also emit an audit event for any changed owner_claimed rows.

Devon: plan proposal: 1) add playbook guard (owner != null) 2) run a scoped backfill for contact.verified=true 3) generate audit CSV for affected CSMs and surface in #cs-ops-comm. Estimated downtime/noside effects: minimal. ETA ~2 hours for full run.

playbook-bot: Deploy request accepted: PR #452 merged to staging. Canary job queued.

Anika: running staging backfill now (200 accounts sample).

Anika: staging run results: 200 sampled -> 12 owner_claimed set, 0 email mismatches on quick validation. Ready to prod in 10m if no objections.

Tara: thumbs for moving to prod once we have the CSM notification drafted. @Leo can you draft a short blurb for CSMs explaining which accounts were affected and the rollback path?

Leo: sure. Draft in the thread: "We ran a targeted backfill for verified contacts where owner was missing. We set owner_claimed for matches with verified emails. No contact data was altered. If you see unexpected claims, reply here and we will revert via audit CSV."

Devon: SQL I used to find suspicious rows:```sql
SELECT a.id, a.name FROM accounts a
WHERE a.owner IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts c WHERE c.account_id = a.id AND c.role = 'Admin');
```

Tara: perfect. Once prod completes, let's snapshot healthscore distribution and post to #cs-metrics. I want to confirm no regression in renewal_risk.

Anika: prod backfill kicked off at 1764444480, will post final numbers.

Anika: prod done — 4,180 accounts touched, 760 owner_claimed set, 0 obvious mismatches flagged by quick-email-check. Uploading audit CSV to drive.redwood/reports/owner-backfill-1764444444.csv :white_check_mark:

Tara: awesome. Please hold off on broad notifications until I finish the CSM message. Posting shortly. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
